name: The Sacred Heart
description: The Sacred Heart is an unoccupied room: minted, seated and declared, with a subject and no corpus. Its subject is the theory of biography and autobiography — the imaginary archive of a canonical life, and devotion in a register that embarrasses. A paper rose is not a failed rose; it is a made thing offered in place of a living one, and offered anyway.
physics: sincere artifice; the record made in the absence of the record
prompt: What did you make because you could not have the thing?
